title: BA Mate: your first guided project
subtitle: Actual 1440 x 1000 desktop screenshots / browser edition / 1.0.0-beta.3 / 1 November 2026
steps: Start with the picture
Read the practice case next, then follow the numbered screenshots. Purple numbers on a screen match the instructions below it.
Connect and create
Set up an AI provider, create a project, add the fictional source and define one goal. Your provider connection and project permission are separate.
Discover and define
Review the extraction, name a stakeholder, confirm the missing rule and turn reviewed AI suggestions into drafts.
Validate and approve
Check criteria, evidence, diagrams and the SRS. Complete Validate, record B1 and keep the goal active for the change exercise.
Change and finish
Change the limit from 500 to 300, implement reviewed patches, revalidate, record B2 and complete the goal. Export a backup.
Explore the toolbox
Later pages cover chat, roles, stories, all five registers, document tools, templates, recent work, built-in help and study status.
result: Main example: Practice Cash Checkout. The separate setup rehearsal illustrates early steps and optional tools. Generated IDs differ between projects; follow the item names and meaning. Every confirmation and approver in this guide is simulated.

title: Choose your route through the guide
subtitle: Read the core route in order; return to the optional tools when you need them.
steps: Connect and create / 4-15
Settings, local setup, model limits, display preferences, qualification, project creation, goals and source review.
Discover and define / 16-20
Stakeholders, confirmed answers, focused API tasks, selected drafts and measurable criteria.
Validate and approve / 21-32
Current evidence, controlled SRS creation, process review, document review, safeguards and B1.
Change, finish and recover / 33-44
The 500-to-300 change, patches, refreshed dependencies, B2, goal completion, exports and project backup/restore.
Use the optional toolbox / 45-61
Saved chat, mentions, quick assistant, roles, stories, API impact/document drafts, registers and document/diagram tools.
Find help and understand limits / 62-65
Recent work, built-in help, the observed study-service state and a practical troubleshooting map.
result: Use PDF bookmarks or click a card. In the offline gallery, use chapter links or search. Screen numbers correspond to the instructions immediately below each screenshot.

title: One checkout, two reviewed baselines
subtitle: Use the supplied practice-cash-checkout.txt. There is no real customer, business or participant data.
steps: The starting brief
Cashier enters order total and cash tendered. Checkout calculates change. The source deliberately leaves the limit undecided. Cards, refunds and stock are excluded.
B1: confirm 500
Simulated shop owner confirms: maximum change 500 units. Above 500, block completion and ask the cashier to request a smaller cash amount.
B2: change to 300
A later simulated decision lowers the maximum to 300. Keep the same blocked outcome, then review all affected records before a second approval.
Test the boundary
B1: total 100 / cash 600 gives change 500, allowed by this rule; cash 601 gives 501, blocked. B2: cash 400 gives 300, allowed; cash 401 gives 301, blocked.
result: This is a narrow analysis example, not a checkout implementation. Approval records human review of the BA artifacts. They do not prove a software checkout was built or tested.

title: Find your project and recognise its state
subtitle: Global navigation / Projects
steps: Open a workspace
Select the project card or its entry in the left navigation. Each project keeps its own sources, goals and analysis records.
Read the indicators
A stage, evidence percentage and blocker count help you find work. Evidence coverage does not establish business quality.
Keep practice separate
Use New project for the exercise. A restored copy is a separate project; the setup rehearsal is an optional authoring demonstration.
result: The original completed project, its restored copy and the separate setup rehearsal have distinct cards.

title: Connect OpenRouter before running a task
subtitle: Global navigation / Settings / AI connection
steps: Choose the profile
Select OpenRouter and enter your assigned model identifier. The illustrated profile is google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite.
Use your own key
Paste an OpenRouter key into its key field, then Save and test connection. A blank field can retain a key already in this service session.
Check the result
Look for the connection result. Keys entered here stay in service memory until it closes; do not put them in source files or messages.
result: Connection updated reports the configured provider/model. A successful connection is the first check; synthetic qualification is separate.

title: Use an installed local model instead
subtitle: Settings / Provider / Local or organisation Ollama
steps: Prepare Ollama
Start Ollama and download a model your computer can support. The app shows a qwen3:8b download example.
Match the model name
Enter the installed model identifier and Ollama address. The usual local address shown here is http://127.0.0.1:11434.
Save and test
Choose Save and test connection. Local inference does not require the project external-processing checkbox; hardware and model capacity still matter.
result: This screenshot shows an unsaved local setup illustration. The main walkthrough uses the connected OpenRouter profile; the first rehearsal also exercised local inference.

title: Understand the task budget
subtitle: Settings / Advanced model limits
steps: Choose a budget
Use the available model capacity or a smaller manual budget. The screenshot records the capacity reported during this run.
Check output and timeout
The maximum output allowance and request timeout affect completion. A large context window does not guarantee a useful answer.
Review included evidence
Each task and chat request can disclose what was included or left out. Check this receipt when a model misses relevant context.
result: Settings shows the selected context budget, output allowance and timeout. Limits and model availability can differ for another profile.

title: Make the workspace comfortable to read
subtitle: Global navigation / Settings / Accessibility & display
steps: Reduce unnecessary motion
The Reduce motion switch disables non-essential transitions and animations. Preferences apply immediately on this device.
Adjust spacing
Comfortable density adds space around navigation and editor controls. Choose what helps you read and operate the interface.
Keep data actions distinct
Export local backup is a workspace-level action. For the illustrated recoverable project ZIP use the specific Project backup controls lower down.
result: This screenshot shows the display controls; preferences were not changed during capture.

title: Check compatibility before a formal pilot
subtitle: Settings / Run synthetic qualification
steps: Run the fixed example
The qualification uses a synthetic leave-request case, rather than your project content, to exercise the supported task formats.
Inspect every proposal
Expand View synthetic proposal for each passing task. Compare the answer with that task and the confirmed rule.
Record a real review
Enter correction counts under the assigned scoring protocol before human approval. Leave this to the study protocol when you are a participant.
result: All six tasks passed structured-response checks in this run. Human review remained required; this result does not establish BA quality or model equivalence.

title: 1. Give the project a clear name
subtitle: Projects / New project / Define the project
steps: Name the example
Use Practice Cash Checkout for the main exercise. A descriptive name helps you distinguish your real projects and rehearsals.
Choose a foundation
This tour uses Blank. Other templates supply a starting structure and safeguards; review their suitability for your work.
Continue deliberately
Continue opens the knowledge-base step. Describe to BA Mate can propose a foundation if you need help choosing one.
result: The first step records the name and selected foundation. The highlighted Blank card is the choice in this example.

title: 2. Add the fictional source material
subtitle: Project creation / Build the knowledge base
steps: Choose the workspace
Keep the new managed folder or choose an existing directory. The app copies uploaded originals into the project workspace.
Browse for the brief
Add practice-cash-checkout.txt. Check the destination folder and queued item name before continuing.
Keep extraction in mind
Readable documents and tables can yield text. Image, audio and video originals can be preserved without providing OCR or transcription.
result: The brief is queued for analysis. Uploading a file does not yet make its claims approved goal evidence.

title: 3. Review governance before creation
subtitle: Project creation / Review governance & create
steps: Check the summary
Confirm the project, template and uploaded source count. Revisit earlier steps if the selected material is wrong.
Review the policy pack
Core policies are locked. Additional policies should reflect the project; AI proposals still require your review.
Create locally
Choose Create local project. Extraction and background suggestions may continue after the workspace is created.
result: The workspace is created locally with its source queue and selected safeguards. No stakeholder approval has been inferred.

title: 4. Define one outcome and its boundaries
subtitle: First project opening / Create a project goal
steps: Choose the goal type
Start from new material suits this initial discovery. Other goal types support existing specifications, addenda and separate deliverables.
State the outcome
Name the cash-change rule goal. Describe the requirement, diagram and SRS you intend to review; exclude cards, refunds and stock. Fill the description if still blank.
Start this goal
Only reviewed source revisions can be selected as evidence. If none are ready, start and review them in Sources & context.
result: One active goal owns the six-stage workflow. This desktop screenshot is from the separate setup rehearsal of the same practice case.

title: 5. Let the checklist guide the next action
subtitle: Project navigation / Guided workflow
steps: Read the current gate
The top bar shows Setup. The stage checklist states the outcomes required before progression.
Open the missing item
Here one source still needs review. Use its Open control to reach the relevant workspace rather than guessing which screen to visit.
Advance after review
Advance to Discover becomes available once the required outcomes are met. A green checklist supports, rather than replaces, your judgment.
result: Setup shows 2 of 3 complete until the source is reviewed and selected for this goal.

title: 6. Review extraction, then include the source
subtitle: Project materials / Sources
steps: Compare with the original
Read Extracted source text and compare it with the original file. The brief intentionally leaves the numerical cash-change policy unresolved.
Accept the extraction
Accept extracted source for this project makes the reviewed extraction available. This does not confirm every claim in the original.
Select it for this goal
Use for the named goal is a separate switch. Check classification; confidential context must use local inference.
result: Both switches are on and SRC-01 is Included. Return to Guided workflow and Advance to Discover. Extraction review and goal selection are separate decisions.

title: 7. Record who owns the business decision
subtitle: Project materials / Registers / Stakeholders
steps: Add a stakeholder
Choose Add stakeholder and replace the default title with the relevant person or role.
Make ownership explicit
This rehearsal names a simulated shop owner and cashier. Keep the practice label; real work needs the actual responsible stakeholder.
Review the details
Expand Edit details to set the owner and appropriate status. A register row alone is not external identity verification.
result: A stakeholder entry exists for discovery. Return to Guided workflow and record the missing cash-change question.

title: 8. Resolve the missing rule with a person
subtitle: Guided workflow / Clarification queue
steps: Record the question
Ask for the maximum cash change and the outcome above it. Advance from Discover once stakeholder and question records exist.
Save the actual answer
For practice: limit 500; above 500, block completion and request smaller cash. In real work, obtain that decision from the stakeholder.
Identify the confirmer
Enter Simulated shop owner (practice only), then Save answer. Review the whole clarification queue before advancing to Define.
result: The clarification is Answered and identifies its self-reported confirmer. Never mark an AI guess as stakeholder-confirmed.

title: 9. Ask for one focused proposal
subtitle: Guided workflow / Work with BA Mate
steps: Choose the task
Select Draft requirements and user stories. This request asks for one requirement for the confirmed limit.
Constrain the request
Specify the rule, equality boundary and first blocked value. Inspect comparison mode and included evidence before running.
Allow the intended processing
External model use requires this project permission as well as a saved provider connection. Run selected task, or cancel an ongoing request.
result: The API request prepares a proposal. Existing artifacts are unchanged until you review and adopt selected items.

title: 10. Select, improve and adopt only useful items
subtitle: Task AI / Review the proposal
steps: Read against the answer
Check the 500-unit rule, actor and blocked outcome. A source identifier or valid response format does not establish support.
Tighten the draft
Use clear requirement wording and explicit 500/501 tests. Remove evidence references that do not support the numerical policy.
Select the intended item
Tick only the requirement; leave the unnecessary story unselected. Scroll to Add selected items as drafts. Final approval is separate.
result: A reviewed proposal becomes a working draft. This API screenshot replays proposal review in the setup rehearsal; its generated IDs differ.

title: 11. Inspect the working requirement
subtitle: Project materials / Requirements & stories / Requirements
steps: Read the statement
The requirement blocks completion when tender minus total exceeds 500 and asks the cashier to request a smaller amount.
Check measurable criteria
At total 100, cash 600 gives change 500; cash 601 gives 501. These examples check the limit, not every checkout behaviour.
Submit for review
After drafting, return to Guided workflow and Advance to Validate. Submit the ready artifact for review; keep rationale, evidence and unresolved matters visible.
result: The item is still Draft until submitted. Manual New requirement authoring follows the same evidence and review controls.

title: 12. Verify meaning at the current revision
subtitle: Review & approval / Evidence links (workspace title: Traceability)
steps: Follow each relationship
Compare the confirmed answer with the requirement and the process diagram. A relationship begins as proposed support.
Verify the actual support
Select the row, inspect its current endpoints and change Review status only after reviewing meaning and available originals.
Watch for staleness
Edits can invalidate revision-pinned reviews. Pending or Broken means review or repair; do not chase a percentage alone.
result: Three reviewed relationships are Verified in the initial example. The requirement traces to the confirmed decision that supplies the limit.

title: 13. Select approved artifacts for the document
subtitle: Requirements & stories / select the intended approved items
steps: Approve individually
Review the requirement and its evidence first. Select the approved item; selection alone does not copy or approve it.
Choose the destination mode
Use Create new SRS for the first document. Update existing SRS and Create addendum are available for other situations.
Prepare the proposal
Choose Create/update SRS. Review the proposed block before applying it; selections can span tabs and searches.
result: The selected count is 1 approved artifact. The next screen is a synchronization proposal, not an automatic document edit.

title: 14. Compare before applying an SRS update
subtitle: Requirements & stories / Create/update SRS / Review document synchronization
steps: Inspect the target
Confirm the section, artifact ID and source revision. Check for content already present to avoid duplication.
Compare the content
Read the statement, boundary criteria, rationale and evidence references that will enter the SRS.
Apply only selected updates
Use Apply selected updates when correct, or Reject proposal. If either side changes, prepare a fresh preview.
result: Applying the reviewed selection creates the controlled document block and a synchronization receipt.

title: 15. Review the generated process
subtitle: Task AI / Draft a process diagram / Review the proposal
steps: Compare with the rule
This OpenRouter proposal calculates change, tests whether it exceeds 500, then blocks or permits completion.
Read code and preview
Check the rendered branches as well as the Mermaid source. Valid syntax proves that the diagram can render, not that the process is correct.
Adopt the reviewed draft
Verify the linked requirement and clarification, select Diagram 1 and use Add selected items as drafts below the proposal.
result: The accepted diagram is a draft in Diagram studio. You still need to inspect and approve the actual model.

title: 16. Review and approve the process model
subtitle: Deliverables / Diagrams
steps: Inspect the whole flow
Review the threshold and both outcomes. Scroll the preview if necessary; the visible top is only part of a vertical diagram.
Edit deliberately
Use the structured node labels or Mermaid source and Save version. Recheck every branch after edits.
Approve the model
Choose Approve only when the current rendered diagram and evidence are correct. Export, focus and document-embedding tools are nearby.
result: An approved diagram can be embedded in a document. Its approval and revision remain separate from the document.

title: 17. Add a version-pinned diagram to the SRS
subtitle: Diagram studio / Add to document
steps: Choose a draft document
Select the working SRS created through synchronization. An approved document needs a working revision before content changes.
Choose the section
Use the existing destination or create a solution and process models section.
Add the diagram
The embed records this diagram revision. A later diagram change needs an explicit compare-and-refresh review.
result: The SRS contains the approved diagram at v1. Embedding a diagram does not approve the entire document.

title: 18. Add context, then review the whole SRS
subtitle: Deliverables / Documents
steps: Complete the document context
Use sections and blocks for purpose, scope, stakeholders, process, assumptions and unresolved matters. A synchronized requirement is only part of an SRS.
Read in Review mode
Compare the 500-unit requirement, criteria and embedded process. Review mode prevents text editing while you inspect the document.
Submit the draft
Use Submit for review when ready. Return to draft for corrections; approved content requires Create working revision.
result: The short practice SRS is submitted for review. Extend and validate it with real stakeholders before using it for a real checkout.

title: 19. Review safeguards and findings
subtitle: Review & approval / Checks & safeguards
steps: Read the finding counts
Inspect open findings, warnings and blockers. Zero recorded findings does not mean an independent assessment found no issues.
Review applicability
Core human approval, privacy, uncertainty and traceability safeguards stay in force. Contextual packs add project rules.
Resolve real concerns
For any finding, review severity, evidence and responsible decision. Resolve the underlying issue before approval rather than weakening the policy.
result: This run has no accepted findings. The next page shows why AI findings must themselves be reviewed.

stage: Validate / AI is a reviewer, too
title: 20. Challenge unsupported AI findings
subtitle: Task AI / Review quality and evidence / Review the proposal
steps: Check the alleged problem
This suggested finding asks for a direct link to the initial brief. The brief deliberately has no limit; the confirmed answer supplies the policy.
Keep useful review questions
Consider whether behaviour and evidence are sufficient. Exact UI copy and register status are separate review choices, not automatic proof of a defect.
Reject unsupported proposals
This run rejected the quality proposal after review. Accepted findings would enter the safeguards workspace for a recorded BA decision.
result: The proposal is retained in AI task history, while unsupported findings are kept out of the governed artifact set.

title: 21. Complete Validate before approval
subtitle: Guided workflow / Validate completion checklist
steps: Check all outcomes
Confirm reviewed artifacts, current verified evidence and no unresolved blockers. Include the process and required documents.
Follow specific issues
Use the Open actions when a requirement is incomplete. Correct the cited record rather than changing scope simply to make progress.
Advance to Approve
Once ready, use Advance to Approve. Baseline recording belongs to the next stage.
result: Validate shows 4 of 4 complete. This is the app readiness result; the BA remains responsible for the review.

title: 22. Record the reviewed baseline scope
subtitle: History & approved versions / Approve new baseline
steps: Review exact revisions
Expand Revisions in this baseline and inspect open questions/checks. The package must include the intended current work.
Name the authorized approver
For this fictional exercise use an explicitly simulated practice approver. Real approvals need the actual responsible authorized person.
Record the approval
Confirm the authorization statement and choose Record approval. The app records a self-attestation; it does not authenticate the named person.
result: The reviewed package is locked as B1. A local snapshot is a separate checkpoint and does not record formal baseline approval.

title: 23. Recognise the locked first baseline
subtitle: Review & approval / History & approved versions
steps: Find B1 in history
B1 captures the original 500-unit requirement, diagram and SRS revisions with its practice-only approver.
Inspect the audit trail
The right-hand trail retains the proposal, edits and approval actions. Use it to understand how the reviewed package was reached.
Choose the next exercise
For the B1-to-B2 walkthrough keep the goal active. For a B1-only practice run, complete the goal when readiness allows.
result: The main run locked requirement v1, diagram v1 and document v6 in B1. Restore as draft creates new working content.

title: 24. Record the later 300-unit decision
subtitle: Keep the original goal active / Guided workflow / answered clarification
steps: Supersede explicitly
Record that the simulated shop owner now wants a 300-unit maximum and the same block-and-request-smaller-cash outcome.
Save the confirmation
Keep the practice-only confirmer clear. In real work, obtain the revised instruction from the actual stakeholder.
Recheck dependent work
Changed evidence can withdraw working reviews and evidence verification. B1 remains locked at its original content.
result: The new answer is saved. The existing approved baseline stays available for comparison while working records need review.

title: 25. Review and implement a controlled change
subtitle: Review & approval / Changes & impact / New change request
steps: Identify the affected scope
Name the business reason, select B1 and add affected requirement, diagram and SRS records. This view retains the implemented review record.
Draft full replacements
Provide a real statement and acceptance-criteria patch, diagram source and the exact document block. Compare the current and replacement text.
Accept, then implement
Select correct patches, Accept selected patches, then Implement accepted patches. Scroll to these actions; implementation creates working revisions.
result: The run applied four patches across three artifacts and returned the goal to Validate. Implementation alone does not complete revalidation.

title: 26. Review links again after the change
subtitle: Review & approval / Evidence links
steps: Expect pending links
The confirmed answer and artifact revisions changed. Previous verification no longer covers the current records.
Compare the 300-unit rule
Check the changed requirement, diagram and answer. At total 100, cash 400 is allowed by the limit; cash 401 is blocked.
Verify current support
Review each affected relationship and set its status only after checking meaning at the current revisions.
result: This screen deliberately shows 0% and three Pending links before they were reverified. That is a review prompt, not data loss.

title: 27. Update the SRS from the reviewed requirement
subtitle: Approve the changed requirement / Update existing SRS / review the preview
steps: Select the draft target
A changed approved document needs a working revision. Select the intended SRS and section, not a different deliverable.
Compare old and new
The left block contains 500/501 tests; the right contains 300/301 tests. Review references and source revision as well as the number.
Apply the reviewed update
Apply selected updates, then reopen the SRS and look for duplication, stale criteria or missing context.
result: The managed requirement block uses requirement v2 and current evidence. Unrelated prose still needs a separate review.

title: 28. Refresh the pinned diagram deliberately
subtitle: Documents / stale embed / Review and refresh
steps: Compare the two revisions
The modal identifies previously inserted v1 and current v2. Scroll each preview or expand its source to inspect the changed decision.
Check business meaning
For this change, verify that 500 became 300 while the blocked and permitted branches remained consistent.
Use the current revision
Choose Use current revision only after comparison. This updates the document reference; it does not approve the diagram by itself.
result: The SRS pins diagram v2 after review. Recheck and submit the changed document before recording change revalidation.

title: 29. Record the review of implemented work
subtitle: Changes & impact / Record revalidation
steps: Review all affected work
Check the 300/301 boundaries, submitted document, current diagram and verified evidence links. Repair issues the app reports.
Record revalidation
Choose Record revalidation after your review. It is a BA review record, not an automated assertion that business software tests ran.
Prepare the next baseline
Return to Guided workflow, complete Validate and advance to Approve. Further edits may invalidate revalidation again.
result: The notification confirms Change revalidated. The next action is a new baseline approval, preserving B1.

title: 30. Keep B1 and B2 side by side
subtitle: History & approved versions / Approve new baseline
steps: Approve the new package
Review the current manifest and record another practice-only approval after revalidation.
Compare the baselines
B2 contains requirement v2, diagram v2 and SRS v9. B1 still contains the original 500-unit revisions.
Finish and back up
Complete the goal, then export a fresh project backup. Use the approved B2 revision when exporting a deliverable.
result: The stored B1 record was verified unchanged after the B2 workflow. Both packages remain locked in history.

title: 31. Complete the goal at its stopping point
subtitle: More tools / Goals / Mark complete
steps: Read completion readiness
Do not complete while required reviews, source revisions, baselines or change revalidation remain outstanding.
Mark complete
The completed card records the goal and all six finished workflow stages. No work is sent to stakeholders by this action.
Start later work separately
Completed work remains available. A later addendum or distinct deliverable needs an appropriate new goal.
result: The main cash-change goal is Completed with three deliverables and all six stages complete.

title: Read the project dashboard after completion
subtitle: Project navigation / Overview
steps: Recognise saved completed work
No active goal is expected after completion. The saved goal and deliverables remain available; use Manage goals to inspect them.
Separate coverage and quality
The example has 100% verified traceability but Quality is Not assessed. Link coverage is not an independent assessment of business correctness.
Return to the right workspace
Review sources, open artifacts or inspect recent activity from the overview. Start a new goal for later work rather than silently extending completed scope.
result: The main completed goal is retained in the dashboard. B1 and B2 remain in history, and a new goal can start separate work.

title: 32. Export the approved document revision
subtitle: Documents / Export document or project
steps: Choose B2 explicitly
In Export revision choose Approved baseline B2. A working export is labelled not approved even when content resembles a baseline.
Pick the useful format
PDF and DOCX suit review; Markdown and Developer handover support other uses. Open the resulting file and inspect it before sharing.
Keep export and backup distinct
Project JSON contains current records regardless of revision selection. A recoverable project backup is the separate ZIP action in Settings.
result: The export control targets Approved baseline B2. An exported document does not replace a project backup.

title: 33. Save a recoverable project package
subtitle: Settings / Local data / Project backup
steps: Select the right project
Use Project for backup. Similar names and restored copies make this check worthwhile.
Export the ZIP
Choose Export project backup. Store the downloaded ZIP outside the working project directory.
Preserve the available originals
The package includes available sources, artifacts, audit history and baselines. Check notices about missing originals; temporary editor drafts are not promised.
result: A completed fictional project ZIP is supplied in the practice folder. Use the backup action rather than a reset to protect your work.

title: 34. Restore into a separate local project
subtitle: Settings / Restore project backup / select the ZIP / Projects
steps: Select a known package
Restore the completed practice ZIP to rehearse recovery. The app validates its package before adding the project.
Identify the restored copy
The new card is named restored copy. Open it and compare its goal, source availability and B1/B2 history.
Check before real reliance
Restoration does not overwrite the original. Confirm important content and available originals before you rely on any backup for recovery.
result: The restore rehearsal created a separate completed project with its source original and both baselines.

title: Ask questions about completed work
subtitle: More tools / Ask BA Mate
steps: Use a saved conversation
Select the goal conversation or create an appropriate one. Confirm the project and goal context before sending.
Read the answer and receipt
The response correctly explains the 300/301 boundary. It also says baseline details were absent from its supplied context; inspect history yourself.
Keep action authority separate
A completed goal provides answers only. Chat prose does not update artifacts or satisfy workflow checks. Stop cancels an in-flight request.
result: The saved assistant answer cites the requirement and clarification. Included-context receipts help you spot what the model could and could not know.

title: Attach the record you mean with @
subtitle: Ask BA Mate / message composer
steps: Find a record
Type @ and part of a name or ID. The list can include sources, requirements, diagrams, documents and changes.
Attach before sending
Use arrow keys and Enter to choose a highlighted item, or select it from the list. Inspect the resulting context chips.
Use the keyboard deliberately
Enter sends once the picker is closed; Shift+Enter adds a line and Escape dismisses the picker. Unsent drafts can be lost on reload.
result: The context picker is open for cash. A mention identifies intended context; the request receipt shows what actually reached the model.

title: Ask alongside the current workspace
subtitle: Top bar / Ask BA Mate
steps: Open the side panel
Use the top-bar assistant while keeping the current page in view. Close or pin it with the panel controls.
Check attached context
Add the relevant records and confirm processing permission. Read the assistant response alongside the actual evidence.
Choose durable history
Open saved conversations for lasting history. This quick assistant warns that its temporary drafts and history are not in project backups.
result: The panel shows project context and attention items. It can help explain work; approval remains a separate governed action.

title: Manage context and external processing
subtitle: More tools / Project settings
steps: Keep the project accurate
Edit name, domain and description, then Save project setup. A precise description improves the context for later work.
Decide external processing
The checkbox permits this project’s non-confidential context to reach the configured external model. This saves immediately.
Review safeguards
Policy setup retains locked core rules and allows contextual additions. Review proposed policy changes before saving them.
result: Provider settings and project permission are separate. Use a local model for confidential context.

title: Make approval responsibility explicit
subtitle: Project settings / Project members
steps: Review local roles
The example Business analyst has the Owner / Lead BA role. Choose roles to match the actual responsibilities in your project.
Check approval authority
Can approve is an explicit local control. A recorded name or local role does not prove who is using the device.
Review policy changes
Core safeguards stay locked. Added policies should strengthen the review process and remain consistent with project scope.
result: An authorized active local role is required for baseline approval. This tour used only simulated approval records.

title: Write a user story without AI
subtitle: Requirements & stories / User stories / New story
steps: Describe the user outcome
Set persona, goal and value. The story narrative is assembled from these fields; read it back as a complete sentence.
Add testable criteria
Use Add criterion. This separate rehearsal checks the 500/501 boundary and makes the expected blocked outcome explicit.
Supply evidence before review
Link the appropriate requirement or supporting evidence in Evidence links. This illustration remains a draft, outside the completed main goal.
result: The optional story is saved as a draft. It is not automatically approved or included in the completed B1/B2 package.

title: Assess a change before implementing it
subtitle: Task AI / Assess a proposed change (separate setup rehearsal)
steps: Describe a concrete change
The rehearsal asks what a hypothetical 500-to-300 change would affect. An assessment does not record a new stakeholder confirmation.
Review the affected records
The useful finding identifies requirement and story criteria. This run left an unsupported claim about lower limits and rounding unselected.
Adopt only reviewed items
Accepted findings need a BA decision. An AI impact analysis can inform the Changes & impact review; it does not apply patches or approve a baseline.
result: Only the supported impact finding was adopted in the optional rehearsal. The main B1/B2 workflow remains a separate completed project.

title: Draft document prose with the API
subtitle: Task AI / Draft document sections (separate setup rehearsal)
steps: Keep confirmed and proposed distinct
The instructions say that 500 is still the rehearsal’s confirmed rule; the later 300 discussion is hypothetical in this separate project.
Inspect content and evidence
Review every section. Section 2 correctly describes the 500/501 boundary and cites the recorded decision and artifacts.
Select the intended section
Only section 2 was adopted as a draft. The model offered extra sections despite the request; selection keeps you in control.
result: A document-section draft exists in the optional rehearsal. It still needs complete document context, evidence review and approval.

title: Make a reasoned finding disposition
subtitle: Review & approval / Checks & safeguards (separate setup rehearsal)
steps: Read the concern in context
The accepted impact warning identifies actual artifacts and criteria. A warning in this rehearsal is not an implemented change.
Inspect source and owner
The card identifies the suggesting model and responsible BA. Verify the underlying evidence rather than relying on the model name.
Resolve on a real basis
Record resolution after addressing a concern, or Mark not applicable where justified and permitted. Do not clear it solely to advance a stage.
result: This optional impact warning was deliberately left open for practice. It is outside the completed main project and does not claim a resolved business decision.

title: Keep an assumption visibly uncertain
subtitle: Registers / Assumptions
steps: Record the uncertainty
This rehearsal assumes whole currency units and asks for rounding to be confirmed before real use.
Give it an owner
Open Edit details and assign responsibility. Keep an appropriate status instead of silently treating the assumption as confirmed.
Revisit dependent work
A new precision rule could change criteria and process behaviour. Resolve the assumption through evidence and stakeholder decisions.
result: The assumption remains Open in the separate rehearsal. An assumption record does not become a confirmed answer merely by being saved.

title: Record decisions with their context
subtitle: Registers / Decisions
steps: Name the decision clearly
The example records the rehearsal’s 500-unit decision. Keep the original confirming evidence and responsible person available.
Manage owner and status
Use the expanded details to record ownership and the appropriate workflow state.
Use the right approval route
A decision row is not the baseline approval action. Later policy changes should still use controlled review of affected artifacts.
result: The Decisions register holds a separate practice entry. Confirmations, artifacts and approved baselines retain their own controls.

title: Track something that could go wrong
subtitle: Registers / Risks
steps: State a potential consequence
This risk notes that a future rounding rule could change equality-boundary behaviour.
Assign responsibility
Use the owner and status controls so someone is responsible for the review and response.
Keep it current
Revisit the risk when scope, evidence or decisions change. A register entry alone does not resolve the underlying concern.
result: The risk remains visible in the optional rehearsal. Separate potential future harm from an issue that already needs action.

title: Track a matter that needs action now
subtitle: Registers / Issues
steps: Write the action needed
The example asks to confirm currency precision before extending the rehearsal into real checkout work.
Use an accountable owner
Expand details, assign the responsible person or role and keep the status meaningful.
Close with a basis
Record a resolved state only after the necessary decision or work exists. Recheck affected artifacts and evidence where required.
result: The issue is still Open in the optional demonstration. A real blocking concern must be resolved before approval.

title: Leave a review note without changing content
subtitle: Documents / Comments
steps: Write a specific note
Identify the record, boundary or question. The example notes that 300 is allowed and 301 is blocked in B2.
Add and resolve deliberately
Add comment records the note; Mark resolved closes its review status after it is addressed.
Keep content review separate
A comment does not approve or edit the document. Use document status actions and content revisions for those decisions.
result: The note was added and subsequently marked resolved. The document content stayed at v9.

title: Connect a document block to its artifacts
subtitle: Documents / block / Manage links
steps: Choose the block first
Open Manage links on the exact requirement, process or prose block you intend to connect.
Check the selected records
The illustrated requirement block is linked to its governed requirement. Select only relevant project artifacts.
Inspect after a change
Block links support navigation and synchronization. They do not replace semantic evidence verification in the Traceability workspace.
result: The link picker shows the block’s current selection. No new link was added in this inspection.

title: Inspect the diagram at a larger scale
subtitle: Diagram studio / Open diagram focus mode
steps: Use focus and zoom
Enlarge the diagram workspace and adjust zoom. Scroll the preview to inspect the full process and both outcomes.
Keep source and preview consistent
The source below shows the current 300-unit decision and both branches. Label edits still need versioning and review.
Export or exit
Mermaid, SVG, PNG and PDF controls are available. Image exports show the picture; keep the record or PDF for review status. Exit focus or Escape closes this view.
result: This is the approved v2 diagram. A good-looking rendered model still needs business and evidence review.

title: Preview a reusable foundation
subtitle: Global navigation / Templates
steps: Choose the closest structure
The library offers starter structures such as banking discovery, people operations and controlled product change.
Preview before creating
Preview template shows the foundation, domain, safeguards and a project-name field. Create only after reviewing them.
Bring your own evidence
Templates do not copy project sources, conversations, artifacts or research observations into the new workspace.
result: The template preview was inspected without creating another project. A new template project still needs its own evidence and goal.

title: Resume from recent activity
subtitle: Global navigation / Recent work
steps: Find the relevant event
The activity list spans local projects. Read the project name and action before opening an item.
Continue in the right project
Use the project cards to return to its current goal or saved workspace.
Inspect the actual record
An activity label is a pointer. Check the current artifact, evidence and approval state before making further changes.
result: Recent work includes the completed main project and optional rehearsal activity, kept under their own project names.

title: Use the short guide inside the app
subtitle: Global navigation / Beta guide
steps: Refresh the core order
The built-in cards recap one goal, source review, proposal review and approval in order.
Look up interaction tips
The help covers mentions, selections, external-processing permission, feedback and recovery basics.
Use the detailed companion
For installation, provider variants and troubleshooting, use the existing three textual beta guides alongside this visual tour.
result: The in-app guide remains available while you work. This visual manual supplements the textual guide set.

title: Know when study functions are unavailable
subtitle: Global navigation / Study participation
steps: Read the actual state
This source-run service reports Study participation is not connected. Local BA work and backups remain available.
Follow the assigned protocol
For a formal study, obtain the researcher’s configured service, assigned task, comparison condition and stopping point.
Keep familiarisation separate
Practising this tour does not enrol you. Connected sign-in, stage evaluation and study submission were not exercised in this session.
result: This is the observed disconnected state. The guide does not present an unperformed study submission as completed.

title: When you cannot take the next step
subtitle: Use the app’s specific message, preserve your work and correct the underlying record.
steps: AI cannot connect
Check the saved provider and model, the correct provider key, availability or quota, and project external-processing permission. Use Cancel or Stop when needed.
A source is missing
Wait for extraction, compare it with the original, accept the extraction and select that reviewed revision for the active goal. Review changed originals again.
Advance is disabled
Read the current stage checklist and use its Open action. Missing stakeholder answers, criteria or evidence each need their own correction.
Approval is blocked
Check review states, current verified links, diagram/document dependencies, active approval authority and unresolved blocking items. Use the exact issue text.
Changed work is stale
Reverify affected evidence, synchronize the SRS, compare and refresh pinned diagrams, submit changed work and record revalidation before another baseline.
You need to stop
Save the intended records, wait for local saving and export a project ZIP. Copy essential unsent text separately; temporary assistant/editor drafts can be lost.
result: Practice success: completed main goal, B1 and B2 retained, current rule 300, 300/301 criteria, current approved diagram and SRS, and a verified recoverable backup. No research-validity or clean-device qualification is implied.
